title: After the Arima Kinen: The King of Roses

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
“Lord Orfevre——!!”
“Lady Rose——!!”

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Etch it into your eyes: My supreme majesty—!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Eternal tranquility, by our own hands—!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(—O Ancestor.
We shall bring it to pass.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: (To the eternity of our kingdom—!)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaaaaah—!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On that day—
A crimson bud bloomed upon the grand winter stage.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Some rejoiced, while others hung their heads in defeat—
yet every single one of them had arrived at one small, undeniable conviction.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Right here, at this very moment, as the sovereign of the racing world.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That Rose Kingdom's—
the 'Rose Clan's' name has been engraved.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Is this the thorn you bear, then?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —O King of Roses.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Glory to the Rose Clan!
May the name of the Rose live forever!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Eternal tranquility to the Rose Kingdom!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Woooooaaah!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Rose Kingdom's performance in the Arima Kinen was widely covered across the media.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Having demonstrated undeniable strength, the Rose clan drew far greater acclaim than ever before—

text_block_list.name: Racing Fan
text_block_list.text:
I heard a Rose Clan Umamusume is debuting soon!
And naturally, she looks like a powerhouse.

text_block_list.name: Racing Fan
text_block_list.text:
Word is, this inspired the Rose Clan to start up
a junior racing club.
And apparently, applications are flooding in.

text_block_list.name: Racing-Fan Celebrity
text_block_list.text:
Whether it be the dedicated trainers chosen by the clan,
or the training facilities
developed by the group.

text_block_list.name: Racing-Fan Celebrity
text_block_list.text: Of course the Umamusume herself is remarkable, but the support network surrounding the Rose Clan has such incredible depth.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her presence, at long last, seemed to have
begun establishing itself as truly unshakable.

text_block_list.name: Young Rose Clan Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Lady Rose! Congratulations!
That was a truly magnificent race!

text_block_list.name: Young Rose Clan Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Everyone in the Rose Clan was so thrilled!
People even called out our clan's name at school.
It felt so wonderful, and honestly, a little ticklish!

text_block_list.name: Young Rose Clan Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
We want to run with all our might too!
For the sake of our clan!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: I see.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Then to you all as well, I entrust a single blossom.
The future of the Rose Kingdom.

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...! Yes! Leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Young Rose Clan Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaah—!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Heh—even from afar, that magnificent stride of yours is unmistakable.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...—
"For the sake of the clan," is it?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Seeing the expressions on those children's faces just now
confirmed it for me.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: In this Arima Kinen—nay, across all the days we shared, we have truly achieved it.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Even if the day comes when the Rose Kingdom drifts away from victory once more, my name is forgotten, and the prestige of the Roses begins to fade.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
The light kindled within them this day
will not be so easily extinguished.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
When the time comes, it shall bloom once more.
Again and again. Truly... for all eternity.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Such an unyielding, dazzling light—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
We have left our mark upon the Rose Kingdom.
Nothing could bring me greater joy than that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Where Rose Kingdom's gaze fell, there was
a young Umamusume of the Rose Clan.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having given her all, she collapsed onto the turf.
...Before long, she picked herself back up and began running once more.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Now, but this is not the end.
The future continues. There remains much left to accomplish.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I can entrust the post of my right hand to none other than you.
May I depend on you?
choice_data_list: Of course, to the ends of the earthâYour Majesty.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...—"Your Majesty," huh.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
I promise you days that will never dim that name.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The horse girl who ran bearing the Rose Clan upon her shoulders
went on to found the Rose Kingdom, guiding it into an unshakable golden age.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And thus, everyone passed down her tale like this:

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...that I am Rose Kingdom, the ruler of the Rose Kingdom.
